criterion.given: I am logged in as an administrator
criterion.when: I access the admin user management page
criterion.then: - List of all users with pagination (50 users per page) - User information: email, display name, role, account status, last login - Search functionality to find users by email or name - Filter by role (User, Admin, etc.)

criterion.given: I am logged in as an administrator
criterion.then: - Dropdown selector shows available roles (User, Admin) - Changes save immediately with confirmation feedback - Role changes are logged for audit trail - System prevents removing the last admin (validation error) - Users with changed roles see updated permissions on next request

criterion.given: I am logged in as an administrator
criterion.then: - Only administrators can access admin pages (route protection) - Role changes require admin confirmation (are you sure dialog) - All admin actions logged to audit log

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR5: Administrators can manage user roles and permissions. Role-based access control (RBAC) implementation with User and Admin roles.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: NextAuth.js 4.24.12 for session management. Role-based access control (RBAC) with User roles: guest, user, moderator, admin. Route guards: ProtectedRoute component, RoleGuard, PermissionGate.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Rate Limiting: Redis-based, configurable per endpoint. Input Validation: Zod schemas for all inputs. SQL Injection Protection: Prisma ORM parameterized queries.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Admin components in src/components/admin/ directory. Admin endpoints in src/app/api/admin/ directory. Admin pages in src/app/admin/ directory.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Role-based access control (RBAC) implementation. Admin routes: /admin/users, /admin/settings. Middleware to check admin role on protected routes. Store admin actions in audit_log table.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: ShadCN/UI components (copy-paste model) with Table, Select, Dialog, Button, Input, Toast components. WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessible. Responsive design with mobile-first approach.

file.reason: Core authentication and authorization middleware. authenticateRequest validates user session and returns user with role. requireRole checks role hierarchy. withAdminAuth provides admin-only route protection.
Route protection proxy that defines admin routes and protected routes. Contains adminRoutes array and route protection logic. Can be extended for admin-specific checks.
React component that conditionally renders admin-only content. Uses useRole hook to check admin status. Shows access denied message for non-admin users.
Example admin API endpoint using withAdminAuth middleware. Shows pattern for protecting admin routes and returning admin-specific data.
Authentication service with NextAuth.js integration. Handles login, signup, and session management. Extends NextAuth types to include role.

constraint.rule: Use Clean Architecture + Hexagonal Architecture patterns. Domain layer cannot import outer layers. Application layer can import domain only. Adapters can import application and domain.
Use NextAuth.js for session management. Use authenticateRequest middleware from src/lib/apiAuth.ts for API routes. Use withAdminAuth() wrapper for admin-only endpoints.
Role-based access control (RBAC) with roles: guest, user, moderator, admin. Use requireRole function to check role hierarchy. Admin routes must be protected with withAdminAuth middleware.
API endpoints follow pattern in src/app/api/admin/ directory. Use Zod schemas for request/response validation. Return error responses in format: { error: string, code: string, message?: string }.
Use ShadCN/UI components from src/components/ui/. Follow existing component patterns. Ensure WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility compliance. Use Table, Select, Dialog, Button, Input, Toast components.
Use TanStack Query for server state (user list, audit log). Use Zustand for client state if needed. Follow existing state management patterns.
Mobile-first approach with breakpoints at 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px. Ensure all interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets on mobile.

Maintain minimum 80% test coverage. TDD approach: write tests before implementation. Unit tests for components and utilities. Integration tests for admin flows. E2E tests for complete admin journey. Accessibility tests using @axe-core/playwright.
Prevent removing last admin: validate admin count before role change. Use Prisma to query User model where role = 'ADMIN'. Throw validation error if trying to change last admin to non-admin.
All admin actions must be logged to audit log. Store: action type, admin user ID, target user ID, old role, new role, timestamp. Use Prisma to store in audit_log table (create migration if needed).

interface.name: authenticateRequest
interface.signature: authenticateRequest(request: NextRequest): Promise<{ user: User; role: string }>

interface.name: withAdminAuth
interface.signature: withAdminAuth(): (request: NextRequest) => Promise<{ user: User | null; role: string }>

interface.name: User Model
interface.signature: model User { id: String, email: String, name: String, role: UserRole, ... }

interface.name: AuditLog Model
interface.signature: model AuditLog { id: String, actionType: String, adminUserId: String, targetUserId: String?, oldValue: String?, newValue: String?, createdAt: DateTime }

tests.standards: Testing standards require 80% coverage minimum with TDD approach. Unit tests for components and utilities using Vitest. Integration tests for admin flows. E2E tests for complete admin journey using Playwright. Accessibility tests using @axe-core/playwright to verify WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance. Test location: tests/unit/ for unit tests, tests/integration/ for integration tests, tests/e2e/ for E2E tests.
